name: Tilpisertib Fosmecarbil
sort_evidence: Tilpisertib fosmecarbil (GS-5290), an oral TPL2 inhibitor prodrug, is in Phase 2 ulcerative colitis NCT06029972 (active not recruiting, primary completion 2027-01) with no approval.

trials.title: Study of Tilpisertib Fosmecarbil in Participants With Moderately to Severely Active Ulcerative Colitis
